address.description:
The IP address or beginning of the address range represented by this
resource. This can be supplied as an input to reserve a specific
address or omitted to allow GCP to choose a valid one for you.
address.rationale: This argument selects the specific IP address or starting address of a range. The appropriate value depends on the organisation's network design, and there is no generic address value that PDE could enforce to improve security.

address_type.description:
The type of the address to reserve.

* EXTERNAL indicates public/external single IP address.
* INTERNAL indicates internal IP ranges belonging to some network. Default value: "EXTERNAL" Possible values: ["EXTERNAL", "INTERNAL"]
address_type.rationale: This argument determines whether the reserved address is external or internal. Both values have valid use cases, so a generic policy cannot require one address type for every workload without knowing its intended network exposure.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: This argument controls whether Terraform can delete or abandon the reserved address. Enforcing deletion protection can prevent unintended removal of a network resource that services may depend on, reducing the risk of service disruption.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.
description.rationale: This argument only provides descriptive metadata for the resource. Restricting its contents would not change the address's access, exposure, or security behaviour.

ip_version.description: The IP Version that will be used by this address. The default value is 'IPV4'. Possible values: ["IPV4", "IPV6"]
ip_version.rationale: This argument selects whether the address uses IPv4 or IPv6. Both are valid networking options and choosing one over the other does not by itself provide a security improvement.

labels.description:
Labels to apply to this address.  A list of key->value pairs.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are organisational metadata used to identify and categorise the resource. They do not directly control access or network behaviour, so constraining them would not generically improve security.

name.description:
Name of the resource. Provided by the client when the resource is
created. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with
RFC1035.  Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and
match the regular expression '[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?' which means
the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following
characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last
character, which cannot be a dash.
name.rationale: This argument identifies the resource, and GCP already enforces its required naming format. A generic policy restricting the actual name would not improve the security posture of the address.

network.description:
The URL of the network in which to reserve the IP range. The IP range
must be in RFC1918 space. The network cannot be deleted if there are
any reserved IP ranges referring to it.

This should only be set when using an Internal address.
network.rationale: This argument selects the VPC network associated with an internal address range. The correct network is workload-specific, so enforcing a particular network would require organisation- or team-specific knowledge rather than a generic security rule.

prefix_length.description:
The prefix length of the IP range. If not present, it means the
address field is a single IP address.

This field is not applicable to addresses with addressType=INTERNAL
when purpose=PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT
prefix_length.rationale: This argument controls the size of the reserved IP range. The appropriate prefix length depends on capacity and network architecture, and there is no universally secure value that can be applied to every workload.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument determines which GCP project owns the resource. The correct project depends on the team's deployment context, so enforcing a specific project would require project-specific knowledge that a generic PDE policy does not have.

purpose.description:
The purpose of the resource. Possible values include:

* VPC_PEERING - for peer networks

* PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT - for ([Beta](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown)) only) Private Service Connect networks
purpose.rationale: This argument specifies the intended use of the address, such as VPC peering or Private Service Connect. These represent different legitimate architectures, so a generic policy cannot require one purpose for every resource.
